title: Dotage
summary: DOTAGE, noun [from dote.] 1. Feebleness or imbecility of understanding or mind, particularly in old age, childishness of old age; as a venerable man now in his dotage 2. A doting; excessive fondness.

inlines.v: DOTAGE, noun [from dote.] 1. Feebleness or imbecility of understanding or mind, particularly in old age, childishness of old age; as a venerable man now in his dotage 2. A doting; excessive fondness. 3. Deliriousness. [See the verb, to dote.]
